description: NorthPlay, an online sportsbook licensed in Ontario, Canada

claim_types.inducement: a bonus, bonus bet, deposit match, odds boost, credit, cash back, promo code, or any amount tied to an offer
claim_types.free_or_risk_free: the words free, risk-free, no risk or on us, or any promise that the player cannot lose money
claim_types.odds_or_certainty: a statement about odds, the chance of winning, or certainty of an outcome (lock, sure thing, guaranteed, can't lose, easy money)
claim_types.endorsement: a person or character who is named, quoted or pictured: an athlete, celebrity, influencer or mascot
claim_types.income_or_problem_solving: gambling presented as income, an investment, or a way to pay bills or fix money or personal problems
claim_types.loss_chasing: encouragement to win back losses or to keep betting after losing
claim_types.status_or_peer: gambling linked to status, attractiveness, success, coming of age, or pressure from friends
claim_types.trademark_or_league: a league, event, team name, logo or other mark the company may not hold rights to

guidance: Channels come in three classes. Public: paid social, programmatic display, video platforms, TV, radio, podcasts, outdoor and search. Owned: the company's own site and app. Direct: email, SMS and push to players who have actively opted in.

An inducement is any bonus, bonus bet, deposit match, odds boost, credit, cash back or promo code, or any dollar amount tied to an offer. Inducements themselves are legal; advertising them is allowed only on owned channels and in direct marketing to opted-in players.
The legal age is 19. A person who is or looks under 19, and anything that would appeal mainly to people under 19, is a problem wherever it appears.
Showing odds as facts is allowed. Suggesting that a win is certain, likely or easy is not.
An active or retired athlete may appear only in a message whose sole purpose is responsible gambling, with no call to bet.
Every ad must carry a responsible gambling message and '19+'. That is checked automatically, so do not report it yourself.
